description: Invasive neophytes along national roads is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by EnviDat: das Umwelt-Datenportal. Streets and Highways are important corridors for the spread of invasive plant species. On behalf of the Federal Roads Office, FEDRO, WSL surveyed the national road network in 2021 and recorded the distribution of three invasive neophytes using AI-based species recognition in a total of 3.8 million georeferenced images. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher EnviDat: das Umwelt-Datenportal. It offers 6 resource(s) in PNG, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: source must be given, permission needed for commercial use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
